act_title: The Prohibition of Electronic Cigarettes (Production, Manufacture, Import, Export, Transport, Sale, Distribution, Storage and Advertisement) Act, 2019
title: Offences to be cognizable
text:
13. Offences to be cognizable.—Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal

Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), an offence under section 4 shall be cognizable.
